item.title: Stop Overpaying for Agents: Local Search, Idempotent Execution, and Thinking Tiers
item.description: Three dev.to field reports read together: XERJ local search cuts agent output tokens to a third of grep; one timed-out retry exposes 7 stacked retry layers and a double charge; 7 models on 15 AIME problems show top thinking costs 3.9x with Gemini 4 scores unchanged.
